# Wedding Website Project - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Wedding website for the Kendalls with Vue.js frontend and Flask backend using SQLite database.

## Project Structure
- `/frontend` - Vue.js application
- `/backend` - Flask API server
- Database: SQLite for RSVP data

## Development Guidelines
- Frontend runs on port 5173 (Vite dev server)
- Backend runs on port 5000 (Flask server)
- Use CORS for local development
